card_title: The 5 ChatGPT Settings I'd Turn On
card_desc: Custom instructions, memory, data controls, multi-factor login, and connected apps. What to change and where to find it.
meta_title: 5 ChatGPT Settings to Turn On (and Where to Find Them) | Olivia Porter
meta_description: The 5 ChatGPT settings I'd change first: custom instructions, memory, data controls, multi-factor authentication, and connected apps, with where to find each one.
sub: Click your name, then Settings. Here's what I'd change first and where each one lives.
intro: Here are the 5 ChatGPT settings I'd turn on. Click your name, then Settings, and work down the list.

steps.title: Custom instructions
steps.text: Personalization > Custom instructions. Tell it who you are, what you sell, who your clients are, and how you write. I also tell it never to use em dashes.

steps.title: Memory
steps.text: Personalization > Memory. Turn it on, so you stop repeating yourself.

steps.title: Improve the model for everyone
steps.text: Data controls > Improve the model for everyone. Turn it off, so your chats aren't used to train future models.

steps.title: Multi-factor authentication
steps.text: Security > Multi-factor authentication. Turn it on.

steps.title: Apps and connectors
steps.text: Apps (or Connectors). Connect Google Drive and your calendar so it can work with your real files.

closing: Menu names move around sometimes. If you can't find one, search for it in Settings.
